title: Cumbersome
text: Cumbersome. The folks on America's Test Kitchen recommended this...why? I don't have a clue. It is stiff, cumbersome, and not manageable. Don't buy this

product_metadata.title: OXO Good Grips Silicone Oven Mitt, Jam
features: Diamond pattern dissipates heat to protect hands
Non-slip pattern provides dexterity and grip
Tapered for a secure fit; 13-in/33 cm length protects arms
Water-resistant silicone is easy to clean
description: The OXO Good Grips Silicone Oven Mitt is heat-, flame-, water- and stain-resistant so that you can cook with confidence. The Mitt features a non-slip diamond pattern that's concentrated at contact points for extra protection when handling hot pots, pans and casseroles. Our 13-in/33 cm Mitt protects your arms with a tapered fit and soft fabric interior that offers control and comfort without sacrificing dexterity. When you're finished, rinse the Oven Mitt clean, wipe it down with a damp cloth or toss it in the washing machine. Includes hanging loop for convenient storage.
